decisions.why: Second upper-wick rejection under the 11:05 high (30,871): 11:20 wicked to 30,844, 11:30 spiked to 30,862 and closed at 30,818 near its low on the heaviest volume in an hour (35.8k vs 14-25k) - a shooting star with trapped buyers above. Target 45 pts toward the 10:40-10:50 lows (~30,750-30,775); stop 30 pts.

Failed breakdown: 11:45 and 11:50 swept below the morning lows (30,731-30,735) with long lower wicks, then 11:55 ripped 84 pts off the low to close on its high (30,857) above VWAP on the heaviest volume in 20 min (31.3k). Shorts from the sweep are trapped; third test of the 30,862-30,871 ceiling should break. Target 45 toward ~30,900 (09:55 high 30,926 above); stop 30.

Failed breakout at the day high: 12:10 and 12:15 both pushed to 30,950-30,952 (double top) and got sold, 12:15 closing at 30,901 back under the old 30,926 high, near its low. Momentum had faded (bodies 84 -> 57 -> 16 -> red). Late breakout buyers trapped above. Target 45 toward the 12:00 breakout base (~30,855); stop 30.
